acetaminophen_rescue.maximum_compounds_limitation: 34-compound maximum is CYP1A2 inhibition using acetaminophen as product, not APAP-injury rescue. Largest reviewed explicit cell-survival series is CHEMBL4820889: 19 compounds, 18 finite standard values.
